# AIssisted Consulting

AIssisted Consulting is an AI and software implementation company. It helps small businesses and individuals improve how work gets done and build useful software with clear scope, human review, and accountable delivery.

Registry version: 2026-09-02.1
Approved registry SHA-256: 3ca531e1a0fcf19268f6182e6510f965a9328738f1885dc3e197027874b19923

## Contact and service area

- Provider: AIssisted Consulting
- Phone: (352) 817-3567
- Email: pj@aissistedconsulting.com
- Base: Ocala, Florida
- Service area: Central Florida, North Central Florida, and remote work across the United States

## Two service lanes

1. Fix how something works: workflow improvement for small businesses, including intake, scheduling, follow-up, reporting, handoffs, AI agents, automation, CRM, and integration.
2. Build something new: custom software for small businesses and individuals, including applications, internal tools, customer experiences, integrations, prototypes, and AI-assisted systems.

Within both lanes, the Private Data Service cleans and structures business data on AIssisted Consulting's self-hosted private system: no third-party cloud or AI service touches the data, open-license models only, a graded quality check, a plain-English fix report, and certified destruction or an encrypted monthly plan. Fixed prices start with a $500 privacy assessment credited toward a $2,500 backlog cleanup project; it is arranged through Contact, not Stripe Checkout.

For Ocala-focused small-business help, start with the Small Business AI Help page. For workflow automation, business process automation, or AI automation consulting, use the Workflow Automation page. For private or on-prem data and AI work, use the Private Data Service page. Then read Services, Privacy And Control, and the relevant guide pages.

## Primary paid offer

Workflow Map & First-Build Plan: one 60-minute working session with AIssisted Consulting and one company-reviewed, one-page plan for $225. The plan covers the problem or build goal; recommended direction and material known constraints; the smallest useful first build; and the next decision and validation needed before a reliable implementation quote.

Delivery is by 5:00 PM Eastern on the second qualifying business day after the completed session. The $225 is payment for the session and plan. It is not an implementation deposit and creates no implementation credit. Booking is confirmed only after Stripe reports the payment as paid.

Visitors who are not sure the paid plan fits may request a free 15-minute Fit Call. It is manually reviewed, initially limited to two accepted calls per week, and is not directly bookable or payable through Stripe.

## Audiences and routing

- Small businesses may use either service lane.
- Individuals with a concrete software build may use the custom-development lane and paid plan.
- Personal and family AI questions route through Contact.
- Grail and other products or experiments are secondary Products & R&D capability examples. They do not imply consulting customer traction or revenue.

## Boundaries

No customer stories or aggregate customer metrics are approved for this website projection. Product experiments do not prove commercial adoption. AIssisted does not promise feasibility, performance, revenue, savings, implementation price, or that every project can be built. Important decisions and sensitive actions retain human review. The website does not collect card details; payment is processed through Stripe Checkout after explicit human approval and acceptance of the exact offer terms.
